title: Derived-publication act payload
description: The act kind by which a derived finding enters the record (ADR-0007). Never an assertion: it records a determination the machinery made, attributed to the adopting actor through the adoption pin, not to the evaluator. The act pins its full lineage with roles (decision 3) — input/choice findings, parameters, the firing rule, mappings/bridges, the adoption act, governance versions, and optionally engine identity — every pin value originating in a versioned/adopted input, never an evaluator constant (decision 4). run_id links the act to its ADR-0008 record pair. Deterministic content-addressed ids (decision 5) are a runner obligation proven by portability tests, not constrained here beyond non-emptiness.
